purpose: Controlled encrypted offsite destination capability for ER-34 O2 tests. No credentials, no key material, no live-provider receipt claim.

encryption.key_handling: injected CryptoKey only; never persisted, logged, or embedded in epochs/receipts/fixtures
encryption.key_validation: AES-GCM secret key, 256-bit strength, encrypt+decrypt usages
encryption.aad: canonical epoch, part ordinal/ref/digest, destination policy digest, key generation, expiry/retention identity
encryption.nonce_uniqueness: deterministic 96-bit nonce per (key generation, copy, part ref, content digest, policy) or controller-allocated, checkpointed in D1 with resume; reuse across parts/restarts fails with BACKUP_NONCE_COLLISION (no in-memory Set)
encryption.authority: controller-owned D1 destination authority bound to initiating principal plus approved policy decision and authorization receipt; caller refs never self-authorize; controller-disciplined clock (caller skew fails closed)
encryption.replay: committed copies replay persisted receipt/epoch bytes verbatim; terminal expiry re-proves absence of every remote part

semantics.lost_ack: reconcile via stable part reference plus content digest; never write a blind second identity
semantics.readback: every remote part is fetched, metadata-checked, authenticated-decrypted and digest-compared before the offsite receipt
semantics.expiry: parts carry expires_at; deletion writes a journal entry
semantics.retention_lock: retained or locked destinations yield typed BACKUP_PURGE_BLOCKED with review metadata, never a deletion claim
